liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jam** (4 reviews): The prelude to the next song is described as unique and utterly maniacal; An intense jam follows the drums before the band returns to the next song [4][9][10][14]
- **Candyman** (1 review): Jerry hits clear notes, reminding the listener of a beautiful jam piece [13]
- **That's It for the Other One** (1 review): The performance is smokin' all the way through until the next song begins [14]
- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): A super tight segue connects the previous song directly into this track [9]
- **It's A Mans World** (1 review): Garcia wails throughout the performance while the rest of the band keeps pace [5]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The transition into the main tune is scorching, and the entire track is strong [5]

## The recordings

- **gd70-04-15.sbd.kaplan.14354.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 96 min; rated 4.79/5 by 62 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording is crisp and clear, with perfectly balanced vocals and deliberate guitar playing; The performance and sound quality are amazing, making it a must-have download [8][15]
- **gd1970-04-15.sbd.lai.6644.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 77 min; rated 4.33/5 by 12 [3]
- **gd1970-04-15.132734.sbd.reel.latvala-eaton-wise.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 101 min; rated 4.88/5 by 8 [2]

## Around the show

- The show possesses such energy that it rivals the listener's favorite recordings from the 1970s [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-04-15.sbd.kaplan.14354.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Andy Lemieux and Seth Kaplan; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Cold Rain and Snow fades in at the start of the tune; The Mama Tried fragment from the false start is missing from the recording; Hard to Handle fades out at 04:31, and Dancin cuts right before the end [1]
- **gd1970-04-15.sbd.lai.6644.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai and Wayne Gucwa; source: sdb> Master Reel> Cassette> Dat> CD [3]. Also: Wayne Gucwa provided the shows, and Mike Lai seeded them to etree [3]
- **gd1970-04-15.132734.sbd.reel.latvala-eaton-wise.flac16**: taped by Bob Mathews; transferred by Rob Eaton and Jim Wise and Dick Latvala; source: Sony 770 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips-(Bob Mathews); DAT x Zero (DL) > DAT x One (RE) > DAT x Two (JW); play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Audio… [2]

## Art and photos

- Photo by Caine Schneider (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 4/15/70 Winterland Arena, San Francisco, CA](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759946133/) [17]
